origins.section: Weak Duality: No Plan Is Worth More Than Any Covering Prices' Bound
Strong Duality: At the Optimum the Two Values Are Equal
Complementary Slackness: Slack Rows Have Price Zero, Used Variables Have Reduced Cost Zero

gates.says: all 3 of this quiz's answerable readings held and each was taken over the question as it stands

recorded.prompt:q-gap: Read the whole lesson page, then this question. Using only what the page states, which option does the page decide is correct? Quote or cite the deciding passage.
recorded.outcome:q-gap: "**A gap you can quote.** The colleague's plan is worth 4,108.7 and the solver's prices prove no plan exceeds 4,109.6, so the colleague's plan is at most $0.9k short of the best possible ... You know this from one plan and one price system, without knowing the optimum."
recorded.prompt:q-infeasible: Read the whole lesson page, then this question. Using only what the page states, which option does the page decide is correct? Quote or cite the deciding passage.
recorded.outcome:q-infeasible: "The dual's constraints (the cover rows) do not depend on the primal's right-hand sides, so prices that were dual feasible with a floor of 900 still are with a floor of 2,000: the dual is feasible. A feasible dual whose primal has no plan must be unbounded"
recorded.prompt:q-cs: Read the whole lesson page, then this question. Using only what the page states, which option does the page decide is correct? Quote or cite the deciding passage.
recorded.outcome:q-cs: "**every row:** slack $`\times`$ price $`= 0`$. A row with slack has price 0 ... **every variable:** value $`\times`$ reduced cost $`= 0`$. A variable the plan uses has reduced cost 0"

recorded.prompt:q-gap:a: Using only what the lesson page states, does a passage of the page rule this option out? Cite the passage, or say none does or that the option is partly true. Be strict.
recorded.outcome:q-gap:a: "A plan and a dual feasible price system bracket the optimum" and "without knowing the optimum". The bracket does not fix the optimum at the midpoint. (Weaker: no passage states the 'halfway' claim and denies it.)
recorded.prompt:q-gap:c: Using only what the lesson page states, does a passage of the page rule this option out? Cite the passage, or say none does or that the option is partly true. Be strict.
recorded.outcome:q-gap:c: "If a plan's value equals some dual feasible bound, the plan is optimal". Here 820 ≠ 860. The colleague's plan (4,108.7 below a bound of 4,109.6) is shown not to be optimal.
recorded.prompt:q-gap:d: Using only what the lesson page states, does a passage of the page rule this option out? Cite the passage, or say none does or that the option is partly true. Be strict.
recorded.outcome:q-gap:d: "every feasible plan's value is at most every dual feasible price system's bound". Valid bounds above the plan values are listed ("prices cash at 0.66 bound 5,207.4").
recorded.prompt:q-infeasible:a: Using only what the lesson page states, does a passage of the page rule this option out? Cite the passage, or say none does or that the option is partly true. Be strict.
recorded.outcome:q-infeasible:a: "floor 2000: primal INFEASIBLE | dual with GLOP INFEASIBLE_OR_UNBOUNDED | dual with HiGHS UNBOUNDED". The table also gives "infeasible (no plan satisfies the rows) | unbounded or infeasible", never optimal.
recorded.prompt:q-infeasible:b: Using only what the lesson page states, does a passage of the page rule this option out? Cite the passage, or say none does or that the option is partly true. Be strict.
recorded.outcome:q-infeasible:b: Table: "infeasible ... | unbounded or infeasible", not always infeasible. In this case the old prices stay feasible, so the dual "must be unbounded".
recorded.prompt:q-infeasible:c: Using only what the lesson page states, does a passage of the page rule this option out? Cite the passage, or say none does or that the option is partly true. Be strict.
recorded.outcome:q-infeasible:c: "dual with HiGHS UNBOUNDED"; "push the bound down without end".
recorded.prompt:q-cs:b: Using only what the lesson page states, does a passage of the page rule this option out? Cite the passage, or say none does or that the option is partly true. Be strict.
recorded.outcome:q-cs:b: "A row with slack has price 0" and "A variable the plan uses has reduced cost 0". Both parts of the option fail.
recorded.prompt:q-cs:c: Using only what the lesson page states, does a passage of the page rule this option out? Cite the passage, or say none does or that the option is partly true. Be strict.
recorded.outcome:q-cs:c: "A row with slack has price 0". 45 hours of slack forces a price of 0.
recorded.prompt:q-cs:d: Using only what the lesson page states, does a passage of the page rule this option out? Cite the passage, or say none does or that the option is partly true. Be strict.
recorded.outcome:q-cs:d: "A variable the plan uses has reduced cost 0". Night shifts = 12 forces a reduced cost of 0.
